description: The commercial packagings of the development plan's Phase 19, each one a flow over the same core. question is what a customer asks; uses names the core capability it runs on.

crisis_planning.title: Crisis Planning Simulator
crisis_planning.question: When the grid fails, how far does it spread and does public order hold?
crisis_planning.uses: city domain pack: power cascade and governance stability score

urban_resilience.title: Urban Resilience Simulator
urban_resilience.question: How late can supplies arrive before order breaks down?
urban_resilience.uses: batch parameter sweep over the city's supply delay

ai_scenario_testing.title: AI Scenario Testing Platform
ai_scenario_testing.question: Which agent does best on this scenario — and is its score honest?
ai_scenario_testing.uses: policy registry, evaluation engine and anti-gaming checks

equipment_screening.title: Equipment Concept Screening Tool
equipment_screening.question: Is this design possible, worth building, and where does it break?
equipment_screening.uses: virtual test: physics-lite, engineering, stress, constraint solver

training_aar.title: Training & After-Action Review Tool
training_aar.question: What happened in this exercise, in order, and what did it cost?

risk_studio.title: Risk Simulation Studio
risk_studio.question: Which pressure breaks this plan first, and at what level?
